preview_retirement_preflight.scope: Began with a live product preview. Normal document deactivation retired it. Its original-state check is false and this run is not counted as successful validation. The subsequent clean display and matrix runs above pass unchanged-state checks.

pure_planning_benchmark.scope: Pure numeric layout only; excludes surface acceptance, exact CAD and display export.

limits: Native selections are programmatic; actual Fusion CEF/pointer interaction is not established by these checks.
New polygon wraps currently require rotation in multiples of 180 degrees; general distorted regions can be refused.
Reference dimensions differ by family; rounded profiles trim nominal corners and approximate arcs with six segments.
This is geometry validation, not physical print or strength validation.
